file_spec.value: In-person applications must be made at the counter of the Migration and Passport Office (Ausländer- und Passamt) in Vaduz. 'The biometric facial image, fingerprints and signature are captured directly on site. You don't have to bring a passport photo.' Liechtenstein has no passport-issuing embassies of its own: nationals residing abroad (except in Switzerland) must apply at the Swiss representation responsible for their country; nationals residing in Switzerland must apply in person in Vaduz.

cross_verification.note: Checked llv.li (Liechtenstein National Administration, official government portal — required loading via a rendered browser session, as direct WebFetch returned HTTP 403) across three pages: 'Passport' landing page, 'Exhibition process', and 'Application abroad'. None publish a printed-photo size/background/head-height spec, because the standard domestic process captures the biometric photo on-site rather than accepting a submitted print — consistent with what was found for az-passport in an earlier batch. Applications from abroad (except Switzerland) are filed at Swiss representations, since Liechtenstein has no passport-issuing embassies of its own; it is plausible those Swiss-run application points follow Swiss/ICAO biometric photo capture conventions, but no explicit Liechtenstein-government citation states a specific cm/mm figure, so size/background/head_height were left unverified rather than inferred. DB's values (3.5×4.5cm / white / 3.2-3.6cm) could not be confirmed or contradicted with an official source, so no db_conflicts entry was recorded (a conflict requires an actual differing verified value, not merely an absence of one).
